programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    g=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])\n    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    div_rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]\n    div_cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]\n    row_bounds=[-1]+div_rows+[h]\n    col_bounds=[-1]+div_cols+[w]\n    row_spans=[(row_bounds[i]+1,row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]\n    col_spans=[(col_bounds[i]+1,col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]\n    chambers=[]\n    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(row_spans):\n        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(col_spans):\n            cnt=sum(g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))\n            chambers.append((cnt,r0,r1,c0,c1))\n    _,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=max(chambers)\n    pattern=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in g[sr0:sr1]]\n    for r0,r1 in row_spans:\n        for c0,c1 in col_spans:\n            if r1-r0==len(pattern) and c1-c0==(len(pattern[0]) if pattern else 0):\n                for dr,row in enumerate(pattern):\n                    g[r0+dr][c0:c1]=row[:]\n    return g\n'''
